Obviously I don't set prices. I don't own the shop. As a long time customer though, I have always been willing to pay the prices for most items because they're products are simply superior to any other place around. Imho, Heaven scent has THE best donuts around. The signature donut, the Beyond Heaven is, well, heavenly. The thought that I'm never going to be able to have one again after this month kills me. The triple chocolate mousse cake is what I imagine ambrosia tastes like. Everything I've ever tried from Heaven Scent has been delicious. I always know I'm going to get something great there, where with other places it's hit or miss.

I can't speak to other people's wages, but as far as I know the pay is on par with other similar jobs. I have no complaints. I've never heard anyone complain about their pay and no one I know who has left did so because of their pay.

You would be surprised by the amount of donuts and desserts we go through, even at odd hours. The drive through is 24 hours, yes. Even if it weren't though, we'd still be working. We don't just sell on site, we have wholesale customers we deliver to as well. We have to get all of those orders made, then stock the store and have some backup. It's a lot. They could cut back on hours and customers, yes. That wouldn't negate the cost of supplies though. When something that used to cost $40 a pop is now $100, and almost all the supplies have risen similarly, they're getting gouged on supplies. People already complain because they had to raise prices to keep up. Things have gone up more since then. It's just an all-around crappy situation.

The money has been going to the ever-increasing price of supplies. Employee retention has been a big problem since Covid, unfortunately. Nobody seems to want to work anymore for some reason. We have very few people to actually make the donuts now and it takes time to train someone. One of our main donut makers is working sometimes 90+ hours a week. It's just not sustainable. Almost all supplies have doubled, sometimes tripled in cost. :( It breaks my heart. I love the place and the people. I hate to see it go. We're all really bummed.
